paragraphs: Ecube Labs sells waste management systems pitched at cities that want cleaner streets and lower collection costs. The company was established in 2011. Buyers are cities and waste collection organizations trying to cut costs by dropping unnecessary pickups and running dynamic routes and schedules.

The method is an integrated IoT-based system that the company says dramatically improves the efficiency of waste collection. On the street side, the bins draw on the sun to compact what they hold. The claim made on the home page is an improvement in collection efficiency of 50% or more. Fewer pickups are also tied to public cleanliness, by reducing the impact of overflowing bins.

The company keeps offices in North America and Asia. It says its products and services can be seen across North and South America, Europe and the Middle East. For public buyers, the site says members can acquire the products and services without going through the request for proposal process. Prospects elsewhere are pointed toward a local distributor.

quote.text: Ecube Labs has offices in North America and Asia.
